topic: Mall analytics data discrepancies and calibration
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main issues regarding mall analytics data. First, a discrepancy in the overall trend graph for AFA was noted, specifically concerning potential changes around January 2022. It was determined that there was no known release or change during that time; instead, the issue might be related to calibration settings (the production setting for AFA was set on 2020-02-10). The underlying session data is available since 2021-01-01.

Second, a reported low total traffic figure in the analytics dashboard was identified as a known bug. This issue has been logged and will be fixed in an upcoming release.
decisions: The low total traffic reading is confirmed to be a known bug (JCDEC-774) and will be fixed later.
action_items: Investigate sessions/packets further if the initial investigation does not resolve the trend discrepancy.
